cash_breakdown.item: Offshore entities cash and short-term investments
cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Held outside mainland China by US/HK or other offshore entities; no specific restriction disclosed, but product mix includes short investments and dividend/friction risk remains.
cash_breakdown.reason: Can potentially be used for debt repayment, dividends or repurchase without PRC operating cash extraction.

cash_breakdown.item: Mainland non-VIE cash and short-term investments
cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: PRC subsidiary/affiliated entity cash not proven quickly distributable; PRC dividend, SAFE and reserve restrictions apply.
cash_breakdown.reason: Potentially usable for operations or upstreaming, but not equivalent to offshore cash.

cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: VIE cash is inside the operating contractual-control structure; prompt default for VIE cash is 0.00-0.30. Annual report says assets can be transferred except registered capital and non-distributable reserves, so use top of VIE range rather than zero.
cash_breakdown.reason: May be contractually extractable but VIE contributes 86.2% of revenue and needs operating liquidity.

cash_breakdown.item: Convertible senior notes, senior notes and long-term loans
cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Interest-bearing financing liabilities are deducted at 100%.
cash_breakdown.reason: A controlling acquirer must repay, assume or economically reserve for these obligations.

cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Reserve approximates about one quarter of cash operating cost base after excluding major non-cash charges; company needs liquidity for platform operations, capex and commitments.
cash_breakdown.reason: Cash required to keep advertising/social platform operating cannot be stripped.

cash_breakdown.item: Tax, FX and distribution friction reserve
cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Additional reserve for cross-border dividend, FX and extraction friction not fully captured in line-item disclosure.
cash_breakdown.reason: Cash spans mainland, VIE and offshore entities; extraction is not frictionless.

cash_breakdown.item: PRC restricted net assets and VIE non-distributable reserves
cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Disclosed as restricted net assets, not as cash account balances; not double deducted after applying low mainland/VIE cash haircuts.
cash_breakdown.reason: Important ownership limitation, but cannot map one-to-one to cash.

cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Non-trade related-party loans and receivables are not cash equivalents; collection and extension risk exist.
cash_breakdown.reason: Excluded from detachable cash pool under this run.

profit_quality.assessment: 平台主业经营利润稳定，2022-2024 年经营现金流持续高于归母净利润，资本开支占经营现金流比例低。但报表净利润受投资减值、公允价值变动和权益法投资影响；广告业务有周期性，且主体为 PRC/VIE 架构。主口径以 US$400m 作为折前可分配现金利润，再按 0.85 折扣。
adjustments: 不直接使用 2024 年归母净利润 US$300.801m，因为其中包含投资减值、投资公允价值和权益法损益。
参考 2022-2024 年经营利润中位数约 US$480m，以及 2024 年 OCF-capex 约 US$578m，折前可分配现金利润取 US$400m。
资本开支未拆维持/增长，2024 年 US$61.469m 作为现金利润验证中的保守扣减。
VIE/监管/广告周期风险通过 0.85 利润折扣体现。
profit_quality.haircut_reason: 现金流匹配度好但业务和架构有折扣，取 0.85，低于稳定现金流企业 0.90-1.00 上限。
profit_quality.cash_conversion_assessment: 三年经营现金流均显著覆盖归母净利润和资本开支，现金转化较强。
profit_quality.maintenance_capex_assessment: 资本开支主要为服务器、电脑和办公设备；未披露维持/增长拆分。
profit_quality.working_capital_assessment: 2024 年应收下降释放现金，但单年营运资金释放不外推为长期利润。
